verdicts.reason: Both are cropped crude zooms of the photo with black headline text placed straight onto the busy hand and finger, so the copy is hard to read. Both also break the yellow ribbon apart: the tails float at mid-height and are detached from the 'a Workout?' bar, and the dotted rules cut across the finger. A is slightly less bad because its bar sits closer to the ribbon tails and the text stack is a bit tighter; B pushes the bar even further below the tails, which makes the broken ribbon more obvious.
